headline: Government and banks highlight financial solidity amid global uncertainty
summary: The Dominican economy recorded growth of 6.4% in June and attracted US$3,276.5 million in foreign investment during the first half of 2026. Government and banks highlighted the country's financial solidity.
why: Growth and foreign direct investment figures are key indicators of economic health for investors assessing emerging Caribbean markets.
